a.lede: An Nvidia robotics engineer that quit in response to Jensen Huang's resignation says he "may have moved too quickly" now that CEO is back in charge.
a.title: Nvidia engineer who quit over Jensen Huang's exit says he 'may have moved too quickly'

b.lede: The president cited the U.S. attorney general in defending Huang's return, while urging Nvidia to continue its export-control investigation.
b.title: Trump endorses Jensen Huang’s return to Nvidia, says US has no evidence of wrongdoing
